column1: # ZAP baseline (passive) rule overrides. Columns are tab separated: rule id, action (IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL), name.
# The scan is advisory (E20-N27); nothing here is a required check. Rules not listed use the ZAP default (WARN).
# Add a row only with a written reason in the PR that adds it.
# 10027 fires on every bundled JS comment in the production build and carries no signal here.

# 90004 (Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre Vulnerability, COEP): expected. Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy would block third-party embeds (fonts, Sentry, WorkOS) and gives no benefit without SharedArrayBuffer use; COOP same-origin is already set. See docs/security/headers-and-csp.md.

# 10049 (Storable and Cacheable Content): expected. Public pages and hashed static assets are meant to be cacheable; personal-data routes send Cache-Control: no-store from the root middleware. See docs/security/headers-and-csp.md.
